Job Description
  
**Power Apps Tech Lead— Canvas Apps, Power Automate \& Dataverse**

  

**Location**

Bengaluru / Delhi NCR, India (Hybrid)  



  

**Experience**

7–12 years in application development, with strong hands\-on experience building intuitive Power Apps canvas apps, designing scalable Power Automate workflows, and implementing Dataverse solutions including the security model — plus working knowledge of integrating AI agents and Copilot capabilities into Power Platform solutions  



  

**Role Summary**

Avanade India’s Business Applications practice is seeking a Power Apps Tech Lead to lead the design and delivery of enterprise\-grade solutions across Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse. This is a hands\-on build role for someone who takes a business process and turns it into a canvas app people find easy and fast to use, backed by a properly designed Dataverse model and automation that holds up in production.


You will own features end to end — data model, app, automation, integration and security — on delivery teams alongside architects, business analysts and client stakeholders. We also expect you to bring AI into the solution where it earns its place: embedding Copilot and agent capabilities in canvas apps and the wider Power Platform estate, rather than treating AI as a separate project.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build intuitive, user\-friendly Power Apps canvas apps — screen and navigation design, responsive layouts, reusable components, delegation\-aware data access and performance tuning.
* Turn business requirements and user journeys into working applications, taking ownership of usability and of how the app performs with real data volumes.
* Design and implement scalable Power Automate workflows — cloud flows, child flows, error handling and retry patterns, approvals, scheduled and event\-driven processing, and concurrency and throughput considerations.
* Design and implement Dataverse solutions: tables, columns and relationships, alternate keys, calculated and rollup fields, and business rules.
* Design and implement the Dataverse security model — security roles, teams, business units, and row\-level and column\-level security — and validate that users see only what they should.
* Integrate AI agents and Copilot capabilities into canvas apps and related Power Platform solutions, including Copilot Studio agents, AI Builder models and prompt\-based actions, with attention to grounding, accuracy and appropriate use.
* Integrate solutions with external systems and Microsoft 365 services using standard and custom connectors, Power Automate and APIs.
* Apply Power Platform ALM properly — solutions, managed and unmanaged layers, environment variables, connection references, and deployment through pipelines or Azure DevOps.
* Troubleshoot, tune and resolve defects across apps, flows and Dataverse, including performance and delegation issues.
* Follow Power Platform governance, licensing, data loss prevention and security best practice, and design within the client’s environment strategy.
* Produce technical documentation, solution designs and handover material, and support testing, UAT, deployment and release activities.

Work with business stakeholders, architects and developers to shape practical solutions, and guide junior developers on the team.  

* 

  

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 7–12 years of overall application development experience, with a substantial recent focus on the Microsoft Power Platform.
* Strong hands\-on experience building Power Apps canvas apps that users find intuitive — component reuse, responsive design, Power Fx, collections and variables, delegation and performance optimisation.
* Strong experience designing and implementing scalable Power Automate workflows, including error handling, child flows, approvals and long\-running or high\-volume patterns.
* Proven Dataverse implementation experience: tables, columns and relationships, alternate keys, calculated and rollup fields, and business rules.
* Practical command of the Dataverse security model — security roles, teams, business units, and row\-level and column\-level security — and the ability to design it for a real organizational structure.
* Working knowledge of integrating AI agents and Copilot capabilities with canvas apps and Power Platform solutions (Copilot Studio, AI Builder or equivalent).
* Experience integrating with external systems and Microsoft 365 services through standard and custom connectors and APIs.
* Understanding of Power Platform ALM — solutions, environment variables, connection references and automated deployment.
* Awareness of Power Platform governance, licensing implications and DLP policies.
* Ability to debug and performance\-tune apps and flows, and to resolve defects through to closure.
* Good client\-facing communication — running requirement discussions and demos, and explaining design decisions clearly.

  
Qualification
  
**Preferred / Good to Have**

  

* Experience with model\-driven apps, Power Pages or Power BI alongside canvas apps.
* Experience building Copilot Studio agents in depth — topics, actions, knowledge sources and channel deployment.
* Custom code extension skills: PCF components, JavaScript, C\# plug\-ins or Azure Functions.
* Azure integration experience — Logic Apps, API Management, Key Vault or Service Bus.
* Microsoft certifications: PL\-400, PL\-200, PL\-600 or AI\-102\.
* Experience with Dataverse data migration and integration tooling (dataflows, Azure Data Factory, Data Migration Utility).
* Experience with Dynamics 365 applications on the same Dataverse platform.
* Experience in a consulting, global delivery or SI environment (Avanade, Accenture, or similar), including presales or demo support.
* Prior contribution to reusable components, accelerators or practice IP.

### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position**

This position is responsible for managing the technical side of our Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) program in support of the organization's business applications. As a Security Analyst, you will partner directly with business application owners to design, build, and maintain role models that support each application's access needs, and will act as an SME for RBAC initiatives, working across business, security, engineering, and operational teams to onboard and govern access for business applications.


**Essential Job Duties**


* Partner directly with business application owners and IT teams to design and implement role\-based access control (RBAC) models tailored to each application's access needs.
* Lead application enrollment into Sailpoint IdentityIQ, defining application\-specific roles, entitlements, and provisioning/de\-provisioning workflows via REST APIs.
* Perform role mining and role engineering at the application level: analyze entitlements within business applications and group them into business\-aligned roles.
* Develop custom workflows, rules, and forms to support application\-specific role assignment, approval, and certification processes.

WHO WE ARE

  

  

The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. is a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and high\-net\-worth individuals. The firm is headquartered in New York and maintains offices in London, Frankfurt, Tokyo, Hong Kong, India and other major financial centers around the world.  



  

GLOBAL BANKING \& MARKETS  



  

Our core value is building strong relationships with our institutional clients, which include corporations, financial service providers, and fund managers. We help them buy and sell financial products on exchanges around the world, raise funding, and manage risk. This is a dynamic, entrepreneurial team that includes individuals who have a passion for the markets and who thrive in fast\-paced, changing environments and are energized by a bustling trading floor. This role requires an energetic self\-starter that can liaise across Global Banking and Markets both regionally and globally. Solid understanding of the global markets franchise offered by the firm and experience within a risk management context are required. Strong interpersonal and analytical skills along with an interest in the broader control environment within financial services are essential to succeed in this role.

description:
**Designation : Developer**


**Level :L2**


**Location : Bangalore**

  

  

**Experience :**


Total Experience: 3–6\+ years in Full Stack or Backend Software Development.


Language Proficiency: Strong working experience with Go (Golang) for backend services (or solid backend expertise in another language with demonstrated Go capability); strong proficiency in TypeScript or modern JavaScript.


API Architecture: Proven track record of designing, building, and consuming scalable REST or gRPC APIs.


Database \& Cloud: Hands\-on experience writing complex SQL queries and deploying containerized services on cloud infrastructure (preferably GCP).


**Job Role** :


Seeking a Full Stack / Backend Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable cloud services and modern web/client interfaces. In this role, you will develop robust backend APIs, integrate distributed cloud databases, and build lightweight client\-side components and browser\-based tools.


You will work across the software development lifecycle, Go services and TypeScript client logic to querying enterprise SQL databases (including distributed relational systems like Cloud Spanner) and deploying containerized microservices to modern serverless environments (Cloud Run).


**Responsibilities** :  

  



Backend \& API Development: Design, implement, and maintain secure, high\-throughput RESTful and/or gRPC APIs using Go (Golang) and/or Python.


Frontend \& Client Integration: Develop and maintain client\-side modules using TypeScript / JavaScript; build or enhance browser\-based tools (such as Chrome Extensions) to streamline user workflows.


Database Design \& Query Optimization: Write efficient, production\-grade SQL queries, design schemas, and handle data migrations with a focus on distributed relational databases (Cloud Spanner).


Cloud \& Serverless Deployment: Deploy, manage, and scale containerized applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) leveraging Cloud Run and container workflows via Artifact Registry.


System Reliability \& DevOps: Package services with Docker, automate routine deployment workflows with shell scripting (Bash), and maintain CI/CD pipelines.


Collaboration \& Code Quality: Participate in design reviews, maintain code documentation, and write unit and integration tests to ensure enterprise\-grade stability and security.

  

  

**Required skills** :


A. TypeScript / JavaScript \& Client\-Side Development


TypeScript \& Modern JS: Strong command of TypeScript (ES6\+) and modern JavaScript syntax, asynchronous programming (Promises, Async/Await), and modular architecture.


Browser \& Extension Development (Optional / Plus): Familiarity with Chrome Extension architecture (Manifest V3, background service workers, content scripts, extension messaging APIs, storage).


UI \& Integration: Experience integrating client\-side interfaces with backend services via fetch/Axios and managing state cleanly.


B. Backend Engineering \& API Design


Go (Golang): Solid understanding of Go fundamentals, goroutines, channels, standard library (net/http), and popular frameworks/routers (e.g., Gin, Chi, or standard Go idioms).


Python (Secondary / Plus): Working knowledge of Python for backend scripting, services, or automation (FastAPI, Flask).


API Development: Deep understanding of RESTful API design patterns, JSON data serialization, authentication protocols (OAuth2, JWT), error handling, and API rate limiting.


C. Database \& Data Layer (SQL \& Cloud Spanner)


Hands\-on SQL: Proficient in relational database design, indexing strategies, ACID transactions, data normalization, and complex joins.


Cloud Spanner: Familiarity or hands\-on experience working with distributed relational databases, particularly Google Cloud Spanner (schema design, query performance tuning, primary keys, interleaved tables).


D. Cloud Infrastructure (GCP) \& DevOps


GCP Services: Hands\-on familiarity with core Google Cloud Platform products, notably Cloud Run (serverless container orchestration) and Artifact Registry (container image management).


Containerization: Experience writing optimized Dockerfiles, building multi\-stage container images, and debugging container runtimes.


Shell Scripting: Proficient in Linux environments with Bash / Shell scripting for automation, build scripts, and environment configuration.

### **The Role**



Trane Technologies is seeking a Data Engineering Analyst to join our ISC Data Architecture \& Governance team based in Bangalore, India. This is a hands\-on role for a candidate who can build scalable data engineering pipelines, analyze legacy systems and workflows, and help modernize our data landscape on Google Cloud Platform.



In this role, you will be responsible for ingesting data from internal and external sources into our enterprise data lake, with a strong focus on the bronze layer of a medallion architecture. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data analysts, and technical teams to gather requirements, clarify business logic, support testing, and design practical solutions that improve reliability, usability, and scalability.



The ideal candidate combines strong technical data engineering skills with the ability to work independently, determine next steps, and communicate effectively with customers and stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle.



This role is based in our Bangalore, India corporate office and reports directly to the Data Architecture \& Governance Manager for ISC.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integrations, and ETL/ELT workflows on Google Cloud Platform using BigQuery, Airflow, and Cloud Data Fusion.
* Ingest data from internal and external sources into the enterprise data lake, with primary ownership of the bronze layer within a medallion architecture.
* Analyze legacy systems, databases, workflows, and transformation logic to understand current\-state processes, dependencies, and opportunities for modernization.
* Document current\-state data flows and system behavior and develop recommendations for process improvement, architecture simplification, and legacy\-to\-cloud modernization.
* Use strong SQL skills to analyze source data, validate transformations, understand embedded business logic, and support data analysts with trusted datasets.
* Partner with business stakeholders and internal customers to gather requirements, clarify needs, support testing, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Work independently to identify next steps, resolve technical and process issues, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality data solutions.
* Apply data quality, governance, documentation, and security standards while continuously improving pipeline reliability, scalability, and performance.

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Data Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* 3\&\#43; years of experience in data engineering, cloud data platforms, data integration, or related roles.
* Hands\-on experience building data pipelines in Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong working knowledge of BigQuery, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Data Fusion.
* Strong SQL skills, including the ability to analyze legacy systems, investigate data issues, validate transformations, and support analytics users.

* Familiarity with data lake concepts and medallion architecture, especially bronze\-layer ingestion patterns.

* **Data Quality Management:** Perform data profiling, assessment, monitoring, and remediation activities to improve data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and fitness for use. Define data quality rules, thresholds, metrics, and reporting to track issues, root causes, and improvement progress.
* **Metadata, Business Glossary, and Lineage Management:** Maintain business definitions, data element standards, ownership, critical data element documentation, and lineage information to improve shared understanding, traceability, and discoverability of data assets. Support data catalog and metadata repository adoption.
* **Master Data Management:** Support the governance of core business data domains by helping define master and reference data standards, data ownership, matching and survivorship rules, quality controls, and change processes. Partner with business and technology teams to improve consistency of critical master data across systems.
* **Policy, Risk, and Compliance:** Help ensure data practices align with internal policies, regulatory requirements, privacy obligations, and control expectations. Support audit readiness by maintaining documentation related to standards, lineage, access considerations, and governance decisions.
* **AI Governance:** Support governance practices for AI agents and AI\-enabled workflows by helping ensure appropriate data use, ownership, documentation, risk awareness, and alignment with responsible AI, privacy, security, legal, and enterprise data governance standards. Partner with business, data, and technology teams to promote trusted, well\-governed, and compliant use of data in AI initiatives.
* **Data Standards and Architecture Collaboration:** Partner with data architects, engineers, and platform teams to align governance requirements with data models, integration patterns, and solution designs.
* **Governance Reporting and Issue Management:** Develop dashboards, scorecards, and management reports that track governance adoption, data quality performance, metadata coverage, stewardship engagement, and remediation status. Facilitate issue intake, prioritization, escalation, and follow\-through.
* **Stakeholder Engagement, Stewardship, and Change Management:** Act as a governance subject matter resource by providing guidance, training, and facilitation to data stewards and business partners. Lead working sessions that align stakeholders on definitions, controls, responsibilities, and remediation plans.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Track industry practices, governance maturity, and emerging data management needs, including AI\-ready data practices where relevant. Recommend and test process, control, and tool improvements that strengthen trust in enterprise data.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


* Proven experience in data governance, data management, data analysis or related roles within medium to large organizations.
* Strong understanding of core data governance concepts, including data ownership and stewardship, policy and standards management, issue management, data controls, and governance operating models.
* Hands\-on experience with data quality management, including profiling, rule definition, monitoring, remediation, and metric development.
* Hands\-on experience with metadata management, business glossary development, data cataloging, and data lineage documentation.
* Hands\-on experience master data management concepts and practices, including master and reference data, domain ownership, data standards, matching and survivorship, and lifecycle controls.
* Experience supporting AI governance practices that align with enterprise governance, privacy, security, and compliance requirements.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g. SQL, Python) and reporting/BI platforms (e.g., Power BI).
* Proficiency with data governance tools, data catalogs, metadata repositories, and related workflow platforms (e.g., Collibra, Profisee).
* Solid understanding of data modeling, integration, and data architecture concepts relevant to governed data products and enterprise data assets.
* Knowledge of relevant regulatory, privacy, risk, and control requirements affecting enterprise data.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively to drive cross\-functional governance initiatives and deliver high\-quality outcomes.


**Other Requirements**
----------------------


**Must\-have:**Data quality management, master data management, metadata management experience across various data types; experience with data catalog and data governance tools such as Collibra, Profisee, Databricks


**Good\-to\-have:**experience with AI governance and understanding of responsible AI and integrated governance between data and AI use cases

With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com .


**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Senior Cybersecurity Analyst is a senior technical member of Fluence's global security operations team, responsible for detecting, investigating, and responding to cyber threats across our enterprise, cloud, and product\-supporting environments. Working from Bengaluru as part of a follow\-the\-sun model, this role partners daily with IT infrastructure, application, risk, compliance, and business teams worldwide, and serves as an escalation point and mentor for junior analysts. The ideal candidate combines deep hands\-on experience in threat detection, investigation, and response with strong analytical judgment and the ability to explain technical risk clearly to both engineers and senior leadership. Day to day, this role works extensively with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Kusto Query Language, vulnerability assessment platforms such as Tenable, and ticketing and automation tooling including ServiceNow. Success in this role is measured by faster and more accurate threat detection, reduced dwell time and false positives, and measurable improvement in Fluence's overall security posture.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Threat Detection, Investigation and Response**

* Conduct threat monitoring and analysis using threat detection, investigation and response (TDIR) tooling, including security information and event management (SIEM) and extended detection and response (XDR) platforms.
* Conduct multi\-telemetry threat investigations to identify cyber threats originating both inside and outside the organization.
* Triage alerts from detection platforms, eliminate false positives, and escalate genuine attacks in line with defined procedures.
* Provide infrastructure teams with incident support, including mitigating actions to contain activity and advisory guidance for remediation.
* Carry out root cause analysis and follow\-up investigations to advise on prevention mechanisms and configuration changes.
* Work efficiently to meet organization\-specific SOC metrics and service level agreements.

**Detection Engineering and Continuous Improvement**

* Work with threat detection content development teams to tune existing detection platforms and create new detection content.
* Drive advanced threat hunting and automation initiatives using scripting and security orchestration tools.
* Maintain expertise in cloud security monitoring and the integration of cloud telemetry into SIEM and XDR platforms.
* Carry out analysis and testing to identify vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and other exposures, and to validate user policies.
* Recommend improvements to security architecture, controls and processes based on root cause analysis and emerging threats.
* Maintain current knowledge of security technologies, attacker techniques and available mitigations.

**Reporting and Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Document formal, technical incident reports for consumption by infrastructure teams and senior leadership.
* Support the development and running of reporting for compliance and infrastructure teams, as well as performance reporting for the security operations team.
* Develop and present security metrics and incident trends to senior leadership.
* Collaborate with IT, risk, compliance and business units to ensure holistic security coverage.

**Leadership and Team Development**

* Lead and mentor junior analysts in threat detection, investigation and incident response.
* Participate in and lead incident simulations, tabletop exercises, and red, blue and purple team activities.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and professional development within the security team.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

Candidates will be evaluated primarily on their ability to demonstrate the competencies required to be successful in the role. For reference, the typical education, experience and technical background of candidates in this role is as follows:


* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information security, cybersecurity or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in security operations analysis, incident response, red teaming, penetration testing, IT audit, network operations or enterprise risk management.
* Minimum 3 years of experience with regulatory compliance and information security management frameworks such as ISO 27000 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
* CompTIA CySA\+ or Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate certification.
* Experience monitoring security information and event management (SIEM) systems and tools such as Microsoft Sentinel.
* Experience with network and security technologies such as firewalls, IDS/IPS and Microsoft Defender XDR.
* Hands\-on experience using analytical and query tools such as Microsoft Excel, Kusto Query Language (KQL) and SQL to support threat investigations, alert analysis, reporting and continuous improvement of detection capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience configuring and using vulnerability assessment technologies such as Tenable and Nessus.
* Experience monitoring networks, detecting threats and responding to incidents using platforms such as ServiceNow and Jira.
* Experience with report writing, investigative techniques and communicating to large audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in cybersecurity, information security or a related technical field.
* Additional certifications such as GIAC GCIH, GCIA or GCFA, CISSP, or a cloud security certification (for example Microsoft AZ\-500 or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer).
* Experience supporting a global, follow\-the\-sun security operations center across multiple regions and time zones.
* Experience securing cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform, including onboarding cloud telemetry into detection platforms.
* Scripting and automation capability using PowerShell, Python, KQL or security orchestration, automation and response (SOAR) tooling such as Logic Apps.
* Exposure to operational technology, industrial control systems, or the energy and critical infrastructure sectors.
* Familiarity with data protection and privacy requirements such as GDPR, and with frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Threat detection, investigation and response
* Strong decision making, with a proven ability to weigh the relative costs and benefits of potential actions and identify the most appropriate one
* Problem solving, critical thinking and troubleshooting under time pressure
* Influence and communication, with the ability to shape the opinions, plans and behaviors of technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Business alignment, demonstrated through an understanding of organizational mission, values and goals and the consistent application of that knowledge

Collaboration and relationship building, including the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across regions and functions


**Our Culture**

At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.

We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate.


**Infinite Impact**

We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game\-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy\-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come.


**All In**

We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success.

description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3\.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5\.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
   

  

 Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy\-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
   

  

 Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9\.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2\.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
   

  

 With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to sit at the intersection of our
 **Security Research Engineering** 
 team and our
 **customers worldwide** 
 . This is a deeply technical, hands\-on, detection\-focused role for someone who understands how attacks against APIs and AI systems actually work — and can prove, in real customer traffic, whether a detection is firing correctly.
   

  

 This is a
 **high\-impact role.** 
 The value customers realize from the entire platform depends on the outcomes this team produces: whether our detections fire correctly, whether the threats that matter get surfaced, and whether customers trust what we tell them. You'll be the technical authority who validates the detections our researchers build (ModSecurity/WAF rules, API security signatures, AI security detections, OWASP Top 10 / API Top 10 / LLM Top 10 coverage), separates true positives from noise, hunts across global customer environments for business logic abuse and fraud, and closes the loop back to Research and Product to sharpen detection efficacy.
   

  

 You'll bring a deep understanding of the security landscape — the threat models, attacker techniques, and rapidly evolving AI security frontier — and you'll express that understanding through code: scripting, automating threat hunts, and using AI itself as a force multiplier in your investigations.
   

  

 Day to day, you'll work hand in hand with customers' own security teams to operationalize the
 **Traceable by Harness Protection module** 
 and then stay engaged as an
 **extended SOC and red team** 
 — continuously improving their security posture rather than handing off at go\-live.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Operationalize the Protection module. Work directly with customers' security teams to stand up and tune the Traceable by Harness Protection module in their environment, from initial rollout through steady\-state enforcement.
* Be their extended SOC and red team. Engage continuously — not as a one\-off deployment — acting as an extension of the customer's SOC to monitor and hunt, and as a red team to probe their defenses, steadily improving their overall security posture.
* Evaluate detections built by Security Research Engineering. Review and pressure\-test ModSecurity (ModSec) rulesets, API security detections, AI Security detections, and OWASP Top 10 / OWASP API Top 10 / OWASP LLM Top 10 coverage for accuracy, coverage gaps, and false\-positive rates before and after they reach customers.
* Validate true positives in production traffic. Partner directly with customer security teams to triage platform alerts, confirm genuine true positives, distinguish them from false positives and benign anomalies, and document the reasoning behind each verdict.
* Automate the hunt. Build scripts, tooling, and automated workflows — increasingly AI\-assisted — that scale threat hunting across many customers at once, rather than investigating one alert at a time by hand.
* Run threat hunting engagements globally. Proactively hunt across the API traffic of Harness customers worldwide for business logic abuse (BOLA/BFLA, parameter tampering, workflow abuse), account takeover, credential stuffing, scraping, carding, and fraud patterns that signature\-based detection alone won't catch.
* Black\-box test the platform and customer APIs. Attack detections and API endpoints the way a real adversary would — validating coverage, finding blind spots, and generating the adversarial traffic needed to confirm detections actually fire.
* Own the detection feedback loop. Turn field findings into concrete, prioritized input for Security Research Engineering and Product — new rule ideas, tuning recommendations, catalog/detection integration gaps, and coverage improvements.
* Reproduce and investigate incidents. Lead deep\-dive investigations into anomalous API behavior, trace root cause (including upstream CDN/WAF/gateway layers), and produce clear RCA documentation and findings for both technical and executive audiences.
* Weed out false positives and report on what matters (critical). Aggressively filter noise so customers aren't chasing false alarms, and deliver clear reports that surface genuine threat insights — helping customer teams focus their limited attention on the true incidents that actually require action. This signal\-over\-noise discipline is central to the value customers get from the platform.
* Reduce customer noise at the source. Tune detections to each customer's API catalog, business context, and legitimate integration patterns so false positives are suppressed before they ever reach an analyst.
* Be a trusted technical advisor. Translate detection logic and threat findings into language customer security leaders can act on, and help them mature their API and AI security posture.


 What You Bring
   

  

**Required**
* 4–6 years in security engineering, detection engineering, threat hunting, penetration testing, incident response, or a closely related discipline.
* A deep, current understanding of the security landscape — threat models, attacker techniques, and how attacks against APIs and AI systems actually play out.
* Ability to code and automate. You write your own tooling to scale threat hunting — this is not a point\-and\-click role.
* Ability to use AI for threat hunting. You actively leverage LLMs and AI\-assisted workflows to accelerate investigation, triage, and hunt automation.
* Black\-box penetration testing ability — you can attack an API or a detection with no prior knowledge and reason about what an adversary would do.
* Comfort working directly with enterprise customers globally — you can lead a technical conversation, defend a verdict, and write findings that stand up to scrutiny.


 Core Technical Requirements
   

  

 This is a core technical role. We expect real depth — not surface familiarity — across most of the following:
   

  

* Security frameworks \& threat models: OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and OWASP LLM (GenAI) Top 10; MITRE ATT\&CK, and MITRE ATLAS for AI/ML threats.
* API security: REST, GraphQL, and gRPC; authentication and authorization flows (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, session handling); and the full range of API attack techniques (BOLA/BFLA, mass assignment, injection, SSRF, rate\-limit and workflow abuse).
* AI / LLM security: prompt injection, sensitive\-information disclosure, improper output handling, excessive agency, and abuse of AI\-driven or agentic API endpoints — and how to detect them.
* Detection \& WAF engineering: hands\-on with WAF / ModSecurity rule logic — reading, writing, tuning, and reasoning about false\-positive / false\-negative tradeoffs.
* Offensive testing \& tooling: black\-box testing of APIs and detections using tools such as Burp Suite, Postman, and OWASP ZAP; generating adversarial traffic to confirm detections fire.
* Scripting \& automation: Python (or equivalent) to build investigation tooling and automated, increasingly AI\-assisted hunt workflows; comfort querying large volumes of traffic and telemetry.
* Threat hunting \& fraud analysis: distinguishing business logic abuse and fraud from legitimate traffic — account takeover, credential stuffing, scraping, carding, and payment fraud.


**Nice to Have**
* Familiarity with CDN, gateway, and upstream traffic architectures (Akamai, Cloudflare, and similar) and how they interact with detection at the edge.
* Prior experience in a customer\-facing security engineering, SOC, or professional services role.
* Certifications (a plus, not required). Because this role centers on API and AI security, the most relevant credentials are:
+ API security: Certified API Pentester (C\-APIPen), APIsec University ASCP, or PortSwigger Burp Suite Certified Practitioner (BSCP).
+ AI / LLM security: a hands\-on AI security certification such as CAISP (Certified AI Security Professional) or equivalent.
+ Offensive / web depth: OSWE, GWAPT, or OSCP.
+ Note: AI\-security certifications are still maturing, so demonstrated hands\-on ability weighs more heavily than any specific badge.


**Harness In The News**
* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5\.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale \| Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success


 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.
   

  

 At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness\-privacy.relyance.ai/
   

  

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**
 We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.
   

  

 Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.
   

  

 If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job\-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced Security Engineer to join our Detection and Response Team (DART). You will help us build out a world class incident response function that will navigate challenging security incidents, drive process improvement, develop an open culture where we grow from our mistakes as an organization. In this role, you will also build the tools and detection infrastructure that we need to scale our detection and response capability across all threats to our Production and Corporate environments.

* Respond to security events, triage, perform investigations, incident analysis, and communicate clearly and efficiently to stakeholders
* Contribute to improving processes, procedures, and technologies used for detection and response, enabling us to improve after each incident
* Develop and run tools to gather security telemetry data from cloud production systems
* Automate workflows and improve identification and response time for security events
* Build and optimize detection rules, allowing us to spend our cycles on the alerts that matter
* Develop runbooks and incident playbooks for new and existing detections
* Lead Threat hunting practices, suggest product and infrastructure signals to surface attacks and incorporate findings into security controls


**What You Will Need**
* 7\+ years of full\-time experience as a security engineer, including security monitoring, incident response, and threat hunting in a cloud environment
* A defensive practitioner who understands offensive security and, the actual scenarios that lead to compromise
* Prior experience leading complex investigations with a large number of stakeholders
* Strong communication skills and a proven track record of communicating with internal and external stakeholders at all levels.
* Expertise on AWS security controls and services.
* Experience leveraging coding for automation, alert enrichment and detections.
* Knowledge of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and MITRE ATT\&CK principles
* Hands\-on experience with data analysis, modeling, and correlation at scale
* Operating systems internals and forensics experience for macOS, Windows \& Linux
* Domain experience managing and working with current SIEM and SOAR platforms
* Experience developing tools and automation using common DevOps toolsets and programming languages
* Understanding of malware functionality and persistence mechanisms
* Ability to analyze endpoint, network, and application logs for anomalous events

description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  


Could you be the full\-time Cybersecurity Architect in our dynamic team located in Bangalore we’re looking for?

  


**Your future role**


Take on a new challenge and apply your comprehensive cybersecurity expertise in a new cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside innovative, dedicated, and forward\-thinking teammates.


You'll lead and shape the cybersecurity landscape within our projects. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (IT, Engineering, Operations), validate security aspects of IT projects, and much more.


You’ll specifically take care of developing use cases, creating business cases with a thorough TCO analysis, and producing or validating architectural documentation. Additionally, you will engage in stakeholder presentations, conduct security studies, and lead design and build phases with subcontractors.


We’ll look to you for:


* Identifying project needs and gathering functional and technical requirements
* Defining use cases and creating an enablement roadmap
* Developing a business case with TCO analysis
* Validating or producing Architecture Design Documents (ADD)
* Presenting solutions and enhancing the service catalog
* Conducting security studies and implementing infrastructure hardening
* Providing troubleshooting expertise and operational support

  

**All about you**


We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:


* A Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering/Technology
* CISSP or CISM certification
* Experience in the Transport Industry is a plus
* At least 7 years of work experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on architecture and design
* A strong grasp of security architecture and infrastructure
* Proficiency in risk analysis and network security patterns
* Strong knowledge of cloud solutions and security mechanisms
* Fluency in English

  

**Things you’ll enjoy**


Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:


* Enjoy stability, challenges and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our flexible working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning
* Progress towards senior cybersecurity roles
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  


**Important to note**


As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-V&M-Senior Consultant-BVAL Complex security/ EGC
description:
**Strategy \& Transactions \| Valuation \& Modeling \| Complex Securities Valuation \| Senior Consultant**


Join our team of Strategy \& Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, strategy, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M\&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.


Position Summary

**Level: Senior or equivalent**


As a Senior at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for reviewing the valuation analysis/ models assisting client with their taxation planning and compliance; financial reporting in accordance with ‘US GAAP’ or ‘IFRS’ accounting standards. You will build, review, and validate quantitative models, interpret outputs in the context of applicable accounting standards, and draft client\-ready deliverables. You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

**The team:**

The Complex Securities Valuation team, part of Deloitte Consulting Services, provides services relating to the full life cycle of Valuation, including policy and process assessments, and quantitative solutions to support the valuation of all types of financial instruments under ASC 820, ASC 718, ASC 815, ASC 480, ASC 842 and other financial reporting standards including complex derivatives, convertible securities, contingent consideration, contingent claims analysis, stock compensation, incremental borrowing rates, equity securities and other investment products. Valuation service offering also provides advisory services to financial institutions, governmental agencies and other private and public companies.

**Work you’ll do / Key Responsibilities:**


The key job responsibilities will be to:

* Conduct 409A common stock valuations and complex capital structure analyses using OPM (Black\-Scholes and Monte Carlo), PWERM, and hybrid methodologies; document DLOM/DLOC assumptions with appropriate support
* Apply and document fair value measurement methodologies under ASC 820, ASC 718, ASC 815, ASC 480, and ASC 842; ensure deliverables are defensible to external auditors
* Support Deloitte US and Deloitte India (Offices of the US) project teams in providing financial consulting services relating to preparing and auditing complex security valuations. Assist in the valuation of financial instruments for regulatory, financial, and 409A purposes.
* Create/assist in creating financial models, analyzing financial statements, conducting industry research, and writing reports
* Draft client\-ready valuation reports and memos including methodology rationale, model assumptions, sensitivity analyses, and concluded fair values; respond substantively to auditor and client review comments
* Deliver high\-quality valuation work products and assist other team members in India (Offices of the US), when required; and interact with internal clients and communicate with stakeholders in the US
* Supervise and review work of junior analysts; provide structured, technical feedback to build team capability and maintain quality standards across the engagement portfolio
* May need to work on other Deloitte Consulting engagements
* Support business development through proposal preparation, pitch materials, and thought leadership on emerging topics in financial instrument valuation


Qualifications

**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Strong background in mathematical finance at the Master's level \- degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance, or a related technical discipline.
* Understanding financial valuation concepts is required. Applicants are expected to have strong analytical and computer skills. Quantitative analysis technical skills and experience with modeling and valuation theory (Monte\-Carlo Simulations, Binomial Lattice, Black Scholes, Options Theory, Geometric Brownian Motion), and tools (Bloomberg, and S\&P Capital IQ) are a plus.
* 4\-8 years of relevant Complex Securities Valuation experience

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* CFA Level II cleared or appeared
* Ability to explain difficult financial modeling/valuation concepts to diverse client contacts
* Conceptual and quantitative depth in valuation methodologies and concepts and underlying markets and models.

**Education:**

* Master's level \- degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance, Business Administration in Finance


**Our purpose**  


Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
**Our people and culture**  


Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
**Professional development**  


At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
**Benefits to help you thrive**  


At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
**Recruiting tips**  


From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

· Configuration and Management:

· Custom Development:

o Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to message processing, data transformation, and connectivity.

o Monitor integration processes using SAP Monitoring tools and manage message queues, logs, and alerts.

· Deployment and Documentation:

o Deploy integration scenarios across different environments, following change management procedures.

o Document integration designs, technical specifications, and user guides to facilitate knowledge sharing and ensure proper maintenance.

· Continuous Improvement:

· Experience with various integration protocols (e.g., HTTP, SOAP, REST, IDoc, SFTP) and security standards (e.g., OAuth, SSL).

· Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.

description:
Job Id: Aeries/377/26\-27
Industry IT\-Software / Software Services / testing
Location Bangalore
Experience Range 2 \- 5 Years
Qualification Graduate
  
Job Description
About Us
Aeries Technology is a Nasdaq listed global professional services and consulting partner, headquartered in Mumbai, India, with centers in the USA, Mexico, Singapore, and Dubai. We provide mid\-size technology companies with the right mix of deep vertical specialty, functional expertise, and the right systems \& solutions to scale, optimize and transform their business operations with unique customized engagement models. Aeries is Great Place to Work certified by GPTW India, reflecting our commitment to fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture for our employees.
About Business Unit
Darktrace is a global AI cybersecurity leader founded in 2013 in Cambridge, UK, by mathematicians and ex\-intelligence experts. Its flagship ActiveAI Security Platform uses Self\-Learning AI to detect and respond to threats across network, email, cloud, endpoint, OT, and identity — without relying on prior attack signatures.
Roles and Responsibility
Workday Systems Support Tech Analyst


Job Summary


As a Workday Systems Support Analyst within Darktrace’s TechOps Centre, you will be responsible for the operational support, monitoring, troubleshooting and maintenance of Workday integrations across HCM, Finance, Payroll and Adaptive Planning. Acting as a key technical resource, you will ensure the reliability, accuracy and performance of critical data exchanges between Workday and internal or third\-party systems.


The role focuses on integration support activities, including incident investigation, root cause analysis, integration monitoring, error resolution, data reconciliation and technical troubleshooting. You will leverage Workday integration technologies and diagnostic tools to proactively identify issues, minimise business disruption and improve platform stability.


Key Duties \& Responsibilities

* Provide L1 and L2 operational and technical support for Workday integrations supporting HCM, Financials, Payroll and Adaptive Planning.
* Monitor, investigate and resolve integration failures, data discrepancies, processing exceptions and interface performance issues.
* Troubleshoot inbound and outbound integrations using Workday integration technologies including:
	+ Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB)
	+ Core Connectors
	+ Workday Studio
	+ Cloud Connect integrations
	+ Workday Web Services (SOAP/REST APIs)
	+ Workday Extend applications where applicable
* Analyse integration logs, event subscriptions, business process transactions and audit trails to identify root causes and implement solutions.
* Support Payroll integrations, including PECI, payroll input processing and third\-party payroll interfaces.
* Support Finance integrations, including banking, procurement, expense, supplier, accounting and reporting interfaces.
* Maintain data integrity through reconciliation activities, validation checks and exception management.
* Support inbound and outbound file transfers, middleware interfaces and API\-based integrations.
* Collaborate with functional Workday teams to understand business requirements and investigate issues spanning security, business processes, reporting and integrations.
* Perform impact assessments for Workday releases, ensuring integrations remain compliant and operational following system updates.
* Maintain integration documentation, support runbooks, technical designs, support procedures and knowledge articles.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend automation, monitoring enhancements and process improvements.
* Work closely with Enterprise IT, Finance, People Operations, Payroll providers and third\-party vendors to resolve complex technical issues.


Qualifications \& Experience

* Experience supporting Workday integrations within a medium\-to\-large enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of Workday HCM, Financials, Payroll and/or Adaptive Planning.
* Hands\-on experience with Workday integration technologies including EIB, Core Connectors and Workday Studio.
* Experience troubleshooting Workday Web Services, APIs, calculated fields and data transformations.
* Knowledge of integration monitoring, log analysis, file\-based interfaces and batch processing.
* Experience performing root cause analysis and resolving complex technical incidents.
* Strong understanding of data structures, data mapping and data validation techniques.
* Familiarity with XML, XSLT, JSON, REST and SOAP technologies.
* Experience working within ITSM processes, including incident, problem and change management.
* Strong analytical, diagnostic and troubleshooting skills.
* Workday Integration Certification.
* Experience supporting PECI and payroll integrations.
* Experience supporting Adaptive Planning integrations and data synchronisation.
* Experience with middleware platforms such as Boomi, MuleSoft or Azure Integration Services.
* Experience supporting Workday Extend applications.
* Knowledge of security administration and integration security groups within Workday.


Success Measures

* Integration incidents are resolved within agreed service levels with minimal business impact.
* Critical HCM, Finance, Payroll and Adaptive integrations achieve high availability and reliability.
* Integration failures are proactively identified, investigated and remediated before impacting users.
* Root causes are documented and recurring technical issues are reduced through permanent fixes and automation.
* Data integrity and reconciliation controls are consistently maintained across integrated systems.
* Workday releases and system updates are successfully assessed and implemented without disruption to integration services.
* Technical documentation, runbooks and support procedures remain accurate and up to date.


What You Will Gain

* Deep technical expertise across Workday HCM, Financials, Payroll and Adaptive Planning integrations.
* Exposure to enterprise\-scale integration architecture supporting critical business operations.
* Hands\-on experience with APIs, middleware, data transformation and cloud integration technologies.
* Opportunities to contribute to platform optimisation, automation and continuous improvement initiatives.
* A key role in ensuring the stability, scalability and reliability of Darktrace's core business systems and data ecosystem.

title: Sr IT Operations Engineer
description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**

**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.** **At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**

**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**

**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**

**Your Role: Sr IT Operations Engineer**


The role requires strong technical breadth and the ability to work across multiple technology areas rather than being limited to a single technology domain. The individual should be comfortable understanding problems across applications, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, security, access, and reporting, while partnering with specialist teams where deeper expertise is required.

**Your Responsibilities:**

**Operations Excellence \& IT Operations**

* Act as a primary technology contact for assigned EKS applications, platforms, and services.
* Provide day\-to\-day technical oversight and operational support across EKS technology environments.
* Administer and govern technology services including infrastructure, security groups, GitHub teams, Power BI workspaces, support groups, and related access.
* Review and approve appropriate EKS technology, access, and support requests.
* Manage and coordinate ITSM processes including Incidents, Changes, and Problems.
* Identify recurring operational issues and drive improvements to reliability, efficiency, and user experience.
**Technical Problem Resolution \& Engineering Support**

* Investigate and help resolve complex technical issues across applications, cloud platforms, databases, analytics, and enterprise technology services.
* Act as a technical problem\-solving partner for EKS Business Operations, Analytics, Engineering teams, and vendors.
* Troubleshoot issues involving technologies such as Azure, SQL, Power BI, Databricks, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise applications.
* Work with technical specialists to identify root cause, define resolution paths, and ensure actions are completed.
* Provide technical guidance to Project Managers, Business Analysts, and other stakeholders when technology decisions or assessments are required.
**Cloud, Infrastructure \& Technology Initiatives**

* Support and lead technology initiatives across Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Drive initiatives such as operating system upgrades, cloud security assessments, infrastructure improvements, and technology health checks.
* Partner with Infrastructure, Cloud, Data, IAM, and Security teams to implement improvements.
* **Security Engineering \& Risk Reduction**
* Review and assess Critical and High security alerts impacting EKS applications and technology environments.
* Partner with InfoSec, IAM, Infrastructure, and other technology teams to investigate and remediate security risks.
* Support implementation of security improvements such as access control enhancements, credential management, and authentication hardening.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to closure.
* **DataOps \& Technology Cost Optimization**
* Support and lead DataOps initiatives, including Databricks\-related operational and cost optimization activities.
* Analyze technology usage and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary costs.
* Partner with Data, Cloud, Engineering, and vendors to implement optimization measures.
**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a key technical liaison between EKS teams and external technology vendors.
* Use technical understanding to challenge vendor recommendations and identify gaps.
* Proactively follow up on outstanding vendor actions and escalate when required.
* Ensure vendor dependencies and blockers are identified early and driven to closure.
**Engineering Visibility, Reporting \& Analytics**

* Develop and enhance operational and technology reports to provide actionable visibility into EKS environments.
* Support reporting around security posture, incidents, operational health, technology usage, and cost optimization.
* Act as an in\-house Power BI resource for EKS where required.
* Ensure reporting data is accurate, reliable, and actionable.
**Application Modernization \& Continuous Improvement**

* Contribute to application and technology modernization initiatives.
* Work with vendors and internal engineering teams during application upgrades, improvements, and technical changes.
**Cross\-Functional Engineering Collaboration**

* Participate in technical reviews and technology assessments.
* Align solutions with enterprise architecture, security, and technology standards.
* Collaborate effectively with IAM, Infrastructure, Data, InfoSec, Engineering, Mobile Deployment, and other enterprise teams.
* **What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):**
* 

* Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 5–8 years of experience in enterprise technology operations, application operations/support, cloud operations, application engineering, or a related technology role.
* Strong experience in technical troubleshooting and problem resolution within enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of relational database concepts, integration technologies, application interfaces, and enterprise technology environments.
* Working knowledge of at least one public cloud platform, preferably Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Knowledge of ITSM/ITIL, including Incident, Change, and Problem Management.
* Experience working with third\-party vendors in a large enterprise organization.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and drive technical issues to closure.
**What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):**

* 

* Experience with enterprise application or SaaS operations.
* Experience with Azure and/or GCP cloud operations.
* Experience working with Infrastructure, IAM, InfoSec, or enterprise security teams.
* Experience with Power BI, SSRS, or other reporting/analytics platforms.
* Knowledge of Databricks or other modern data platforms.
* Experience supporting application modernization or technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience with IoT projects.
* Relevant cloud, ITSM, security, or technology certifications.
**Additional Information:**

* Travel: 0%
* Location: India, Bangalore

title: Information Security Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Title**


Information Security Operations Engineer**Job Description Summary**


Selected Candidate works within the Security Operations Center to improve, tune, and enhance security alerts, responses, and remediation of detected issues The engineer will also work within the Incident Management process to remove threats and vulnerabilities within the organization. This role collaborates with other Information Security and IT Operational teams to maintain a secure environment and incident response capabilities. As part of the Global Security Operations Center team, he/she should be responsible for improving security operations and monitoring security events in EDR, permitter scanning, threat detection, preventative advanced threat hunting, across all security tools. This job requires Flexibility of working in 24/7 rotational shifts which includes night shift and weekends.**Job Description**

* Serves as the regional point of contact for security escalations/requests and escalates requests to Security architecture as needed.
* Responsible for the identification and assessment of enterprise risks. Identifies, evaluates, and tests appropriate security products, tools, and systems to ensure alignment with the CushWake global security posture
* Articulates security policies, guidelines and standards to customers and developers. Able to apply theories, concepts, principles, and methodologies to difficult but conventional assignments. Assignments are given in terms of objectives to be met.
* Works independently within an established framework.
* Develop techniques and procedures for conducting IS and cyber security risk assessments and compliance audits, the evaluation and testing of hardware, firmware, and software for possible impact on system security, and the investigation and resolution of security incidents.
* Implement IS and cyber security policies and take measures against intrusion, frauds, attacks, or leaks.
* Continue to build knowledge of the organization, processes, and customers. Performs a range of straightforward assignments. Use prescribed guidelines or policies to analyze and resolve problems. Receives a moderate level of guidance and direction
* Partners with Security Architecture on critical scope delivery
* Reviews security INC(s) to ensure proper processes have been followed and to identify additional IoA(s)/IoC(s).
* Perform proactive threat hunting using hypothesis, and telemetry from endpoints, identities, cloud and network to identify malicious activity, abnormal behaviors, and emerging attacker techniques.
* Serves as the security stakeholder for IR/MIM activities until Security Architecture and/or senior leadership can engage.

  


INCO: “Cushman \& Wakefield”
